title: fix(spec,metadata-protocol)!: retire the seed modes insert and replace, which inserted every record again on each replay
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBFyg5B2muWbKZjA9phXVWse)_

Fixes #34613

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: follow-up #34798

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：seed 的 `mode` 去掉 `insert` 和 `replace`，只剩 `update` / `upsert` / `ignore`（默认 `ignore` 不变）。写这两个值的数据集在 `defineSeed` / `defineStack` / `os validate` / 保存与发布门被拒，报错直接写出改法；已经存下来的旧数据集在启动、组织重放、热重载、安装时单独拒收，其余数据集照常加载。场景跑分器的种子改用默认 `ignore`；它把被某一轮删掉的种子行放回去时改走该数据包的 sample-data reseed（安装门会按落地记录扣下被删的种子行），放不回的行点名报出，不再记成已放回。
- 为什么改：按裁定 6942780880（选 B）。seed 每次启动、安装、发布都会重放，这两种模式不匹配已有行，所以每次重放都再插一遍：实测三次启动 1→2→3 行，人员引用只在最新那行补上。
- 风险与回滚：收窄，不是 Tier H：check-governed-merges 判定不在受治理面（0/86 路径，+1473 / −532 共 2005 行）；裁决 6942780880 第 4 步是 seat-2 的执行文字，不是维护者原话，维护者对本卡的原话是「接受未知,评审完就合」（6949639011）。源头侧存量为零（本仓、hotcrm、cloud main 9cce314 都没有；托管 AI 构建器只写 `upsert`，读数见 #34479 评论 6943182271）；托管环境里已存的包体读不到，是未知面，见 Acceptance notes。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/data/seed.zod.ts` 的 `SeedMode`（`enumWithRetiredValues` 带处方）；`packages/metadata-protocol/src/seed-loader.ts` 新增的 `loadStored` 和 `loadDataset` 开头的模式拒收；`packages/metadata/src/artifact-retired-seed-modes.ts`（已编译制品里的旧数据集先摘出再严格解析、解析后放回，整机照常启动）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run src/seed-loader-retired-mode-34613.test.ts`，预期 8 例全绿；制品启动：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/standalone-stack-artifact-retired-seed-mode-34613.test.ts`，预期 3 例全绿。
- 需要你做的：无。维护者已接受托管存量未知（6949639011「接受未知,评审完就合」）；区域在 L1、席位契约评审和终 head 的 dogfood 电池通过后落地。

## What changes

Per the maintainer's ruling on this card (comment 6942780880, option **B**): retire the seed modes `insert` and `replace`.

- **`SeedMode` (`@objectstack/spec/data`)** narrows from `insert | update | upsert | replace | ignore` to `update | upsert | ignore`, default `ignore` unchanged. The two values are kept as retired enum values (`enumWithRetiredValues`, ADR-0049), so `mode: 'insert'` / `mode: 'replace'` fail parse with a prescription that names the fix: keep the default `mode: 'ignore'` (or `'upsert'`) and set `externalId` to the field that names a row, to a list of fields when no single field does, or to `'id'` when the records carry their own ids. `defineSeed`, `defineStack`, `os validate` / `os build` and the metadata save and publish doors all refuse through that one parse.
- **Stored datasets are refused alone, loudly.** A package built before this change, or a seed already stored, can still carry a retired mode. `SeedLoaderService.loadStored` (`@objectstack/metadata-protocol`) is the funnel the replaying loads now go through: the single-tenant boot seed, the per-organization replay, the dev hot reload (`packages/runtime/src/app-plugin.ts`) and the marketplace local install (`packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts`). A retired-mode dataset writes nothing; the load result carries one error for it with the schema's prescription and `success: false`; every other dataset loads. A dataset that is malformed for any other reason still fails the whole parse, as before. The publish doors keep their whole-request refusal (422), unchanged.
- **Compiled artifacts still boot.** The artifact door (`MetadataPlugin._parseAndRegisterArtifact`, `@objectstack/metadata`) strict-parses the whole definition, so a stale `objectstack.json` carrying one retired-mode dataset would otherwise abort the boot. The door now takes such a dataset out of every seed collection the artifact can hold (top-level `data`, `manifest.data`, each assembled package body's `data` and `manifest.data`) before the parse, hands it back to the same collection afterwards, and logs one warning naming it and the fix; the seed load then refuses it alone. Seeds are never registered as metadata items, so nothing else reads the handed-back dataset. A never-valid mode is still the door's parse refusal. (L2 review M1.)
- **The loader refuses the mode itself.** `loadDataset` refuses a mode outside the live `SeedMode` set before any write, so `load()` and `validate()` handed an unparsed request answer what a real load does: nothing written, every record errored, the prescription as the error, logged at `error`. The `insert` / `replace` arms are removed from `writeRecord` and `decideWriteAction`. A request with no mode at all keeps its old path. (L2 review S1.)
- **`RETIRED_SEED_MODE_VALUES`** (`@objectstack/spec/data`, new export): the retired values, membership only, read by the artifact door and the loader so neither restates the list.
- **Hints repointed.** The save door's and the loader's hint for a key no record carries used to say "or use mode 'insert' for rows with no natural key", steering into the one mode that duplicates. It now names a list of fields or `'id'`.
- **Scenario runner restore (contract review 6969536704, M3).** The runner's seed datasets carry no `mode` (default `ignore`). The install door keeps the organization's record of landed seed rows (`sys_seed_landed_key`, no package in the key) and installs under `honour`, which withholds a recorded row that is gone (`skipped`, no error), so a restore sent as a second data-only package put nothing back, booked the row as reinserted, and after three rounds left the later operations of template mode's iterate-run half `notMeasured`. `loadSeedRows` (`packages/qa/scenarios/src/runner/orchestrate.ts`) now reads the door's `skipped`: the restore goes on through that package's sample-data reseed (`POST /api/v1/marketplace/install-local/:manifestId/reseed-sample-data`, the deliberate re-seed; `AppHarness.reseedManaged`, optional), and whenever the door skipped a row the objects are read back and each row still not there is refused by name with the reason, never counted as written or reinserted. A dataset refused whole (`field: 'mode'`) refuses each of its rows (N23). The install door's behaviour is unchanged (`honour` stays). The test double's door keeps the landed-row record and answers a retired mode with one dataset entry, as the real door does (N22).
- **Lint.** The advisory rule `seed-insert-mode-duplicates-on-replay` (`validateSeedReplaySafety`) is removed; the schema refusal does its job for both modes. Author-time rule count 71 → 70 at the merged head (main is at 71 after #34822 and a later rule; this PR retires one; the four docs transcripts follow).
- **`os diff`** on a dataset declaring either mode says the mode is retired, that a replay refuses the dataset, and what to declare.
- **Conversion route (same PR, per the seat's 08:47Z order).** `content/docs/data-modeling/seed-data.mdx` › *Moving off `insert` and `replace`* gives the three conversions (a field, a composite list, `'id'`), a before/after, the rebuild/reinstall step. Step 2 says a reference the first load leaves empty still belongs in a composite key: since main's #34854 each later load finds that row by the key as authored, and the load that can resolve the reference fills it in. ADR-0087 D3 entry `seed-mode-insert-replace-retired` (no D2 conversion: which field names a row is the author's to declare).
- Changeset `.changeset/34613-seed-mode-insert-replace-retired.md`; reference docs regenerated.

## Verification

- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/seed-loader-retired-mode-34613.test.ts` (new, 8): through `loadStored`, insert / replace each refused alone while two other datasets land; an all-refused load answers failed with nothing written; `load()` handed an unparsed retired dataset refuses it (nothing written, every record errored, one `error` log) while the other dataset lands; `validate()` answers the same refusal; controls: no retired dataset → `load()`'s answer unchanged; a never-valid mode (`merge`) still fails the whole parse.
- `packages/runtime/src/standalone-stack-artifact-retired-seed-mode-34613.test.ts` (new, 3): a real `createStandaloneStack` boot over a compiled artifact carrying an `insert` (and a `replace`) dataset completes, the dataset's object registers, the keyed dataset lands, the stale one writes nothing; control: a `merge` mode still fails the door's parse.
- `packages/metadata/src/artifact-retired-seed-modes.test.ts` (new, 3): every seed collection path, the input not mutated, the hand-back to the same collection, and the control that a never-valid mode is left to the parse.
- `packages/spec/src/data/seed.test.ts`: the two values refused with the prescription at path `['mode']`; the live modes parse.
- `protocol.seed-external-id-refusal` tests: insert / replace now refused at the save door with the prescription, nothing stored.
- `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-landed-keys.test.ts` (new top-level describe, 2): through the real door and `SeedLoaderService`, a data-only package keyed on `id` seeds `ct1`, `ct2`; `ct2` is deleted; a second package carrying `ct2` answers `inserted: 0, skipped: 1, errors: 0, errorList: []` and the row stays gone; that package's reseed answers `inserted: 1` and the row is back; control: an unrecorded row lands from a second package. This confirms M3 at the door.
- `packages/qa/scenarios/test/runner/orchestrate.test.ts`: the double's control (an install withholds a recorded row that is gone, the reseed brings it back, a held row is skipped, an unrecorded row lands, an unknown package's reseed is 404); a restore puts back a withheld row through exactly one reseed of the restore package; a harness with no reseed door refuses the row by name (`sys_seed_landed_key`, `no reseed door`) and books nothing as reinserted. Before the runner fix, with the honest double, 7 of 150 tests were red, among them the crm card's `runCard` (template iterate-run operations `notMeasured: 3`) and every restore pin (`demotravel_expense_claim: 1 missing (c001)`, `democrm_account: 1 missing (ac1)`); after it 153 of 153 pass. Ablation at `1f74fbc7` through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (`{ reseedWithheld: true }` removed from the restore's call, anchor 1 → 0, blob `902855e2` → `446674cf`): 8 red, restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Real boot, three boots over one SQLite file with `OrganizationsPlugin` (scratch probe through `@objectstack/verify` `bootStack`, not committed), a task dataset plus a keyed tag dataset, a person signing up before boot 3:

  | task dataset | boot 1 | boot 2 | boot 3 |
  |---|---|---|---|
  | `mode: 'insert'` | refused, 0 rows (tag: 1) | refused, 0 (tag: 1) | refused, 0 (tag: 1) |
  | `mode: 'replace'` | refused, 0 (tag: 1) | refused, 0 (tag: 1) | refused, 0 (tag: 1) |
  | converted: `externalId: 'name'` | 1 row | same id | same id, now names the person |
  | `externalId: ['name', 'assignee']` (person not yet signed up) | 1 | 2 | 3 |

  Each refusal logs `✗ Seed dataset for 'seedowner_task' was not loaded: <prescription>`. The last row was measured at `ef48f915`, before main's #34854 (card #34800) fixed it: such a row is now found again by its authored key on every later load and filled once the person resolves. The docs caveat and the "list only fields every load can fill" advice built on that row were removed at `f596517c` (seat S2, finding 6957342048).
- `defineStack` with `mode: 'insert'` → `✗ data.0.mode: seed.mode: 'insert' was removed …`.

## Acceptance notes

- **FROM, measured on `origin/main` e5336512** (premise reading): `insert` keyed by name 1 → 2 → 3 rows over three boots, only the newest row naming the person; keyless `insert` and `replace` the same; with a `unique` field the replay insert was refused and the one row stayed empty; `ignore` control one row, same id. TO: both values refused; a converted dataset holds one row.
- **Stock reading and its source.** Source-side stock is zero from `863908f4` on, which drops the scenario runner's `mode: 'insert'` (`loadSeedRows`, brought in by main's #34985; seat delta-4 M2, amendment 6967843392): no non-test `mode: 'insert'` / `'replace'` in this repo, hotcrm, or cloud `main` 9cce314, and the hosted AI builder writes only `upsert` (cloud seat reading, #34479 comment 6943182271). **Unknown surface:** stored seed metadata and installed package bodies in hosted environments could not be read (no production credentials). A stored dataset there carrying either mode is refused alone at its next replay with the fix in the message, and the rest of its package loads; a compiled artifact carrying one still boots (pinned above). The maintainer accepted the unknown (6949639011, 「接受未知,评审完就合」), so landing does not wait on a count.
- Rows earlier replays duplicated are data and are left as they are.
- L2 nits not changed here: N1 (the boot banner's Seeds row counts no rejection when a refused dataset loads beside others; the refusal is still logged), N2 (the prescriptions and the docs name 18.7.0: the 18.6.0 cut, Version PR #33849, merged at 2026-11-18T05:13Z without this PR; this PR's `@objectstack/spec` changeset is `minor` over 18.6.0, `@objectstack/spec` is in the changeset `fixed` group, and no pending changeset on `main` or here bumps a package of that group `major`, so the first release carrying the refusal is 18.7.0), N4 (an admitted dataset whose `dependsOn` names the refused dataset's object is refused by the dependency check with its own message), N5 (`loadStored` is not on `ISeedLoaderService`; adding it is a contract change of its own), N6 (the refusal rides the existing error shape with `recordIndex: 0`).
- **Follow-ups filed.** #34798 (blocked by this card): `skills/objectstack-data/references/seeds.md` and `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` still teach the retired modes. #34800 (a composite `externalId` over a reference the first load leaves empty) was fixed on main by #34854 while this PR was open; this branch carries that fix through the main merge. #34963: the local artifact checksum is computed before withheld datasets are restored (seat N10). #34975 (p2, area takes it right after this merge): the platform-checklist items `platform-core.seed-mode-matrix` and `access-security.agent-ceiling-set-assignment-refusal` still exercise the retired modes (the daily checklist watchdog is expected to go red on `main` until it lands), FOLLOW-UPS K6, and three stale comments (seat N14, N16, N18).
